note: Values transcribed verbatim from the manufacturer spec tables. Empty/unreadable cells are null - no values are estimated. Every item carries the same key set; a null means either the cell was empty/non-numeric (e.g. 'TAPERED', the range '40-35.5') or that column does not exist in that source table. 'bend_point' is the kick point. 'model' is the exact model text of its table; combine with 'section' for the full product name. 'raw' holds the untouched original cell text of every column that the source table actually had.
